Measured on this host's own MPSGraph and compared cell for cell by tests/backports/host/mpsgraph/run.sh in a process of its own: 9 cases over both forms and their result shapes, every cell and every shape byte-identical to the release (gather_slice checks=9 failures=0 recorded=0 over 44 cells). Three shapes the release refuses, each with its own words and each a question refusals.m asks in a process of its own: a start past the end of the axis ("start value 9 does not fit dimension size (4)"), a length that runs past it ("length value 9 does not fit within the dimension size (4) with start value (2)"), a stride of zero ("stride cannot be 0"), and a result of no elements, which the release BUILDS (the shape line prints 2x0) and then cannot make an NDArray for ("device may not be nil", MPSNDArray.mm:759).
